description: Per-cycle energy comparison between clusterlifter engine (E0081) and unmodified engine (E0031) at Gamma 5, seed 1, 2D, L=100. For each condition, compares events/particle, plate_work, pair_dissipation, and energy_residual_rel over the cycles both engines completed. Also reports clusterlifter-only events/particle for all cycles it ran, and hold energy fraction from counters.json.

sources.clusterlifter: E0081 (clusterlifter v3, hold energy mixed into plate_dissipation)
